name: dsh-llm-claude
description: Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): live model list, session resume, images, tool activity

scripts.test: node src/adapter.test.js && node src/transcript.test.js && node src/mcp.test.js
scripts.check: oxlint src/ --max-warnings=0 && oxfmt --check src/ && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production bun build src/client/index.jsx --format=cjs --target=browser --outfile=lib/client.js --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external '@deepseek-ai/*' --banner='window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "dsh-llm-claude", factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;' --footer='return module.exports; } });'
